parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-26 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 17.9 | 13.68 | 13.68
2 | 50.4 | 5.82 | 19.50
3 | 514.6 | 0.68 | 20.18
4 | 502.0 | 17.67 | 37.85
5 | 194.4 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-26
Curve type: Q-type
Aquifer depth: 20.18 - 37.85 m
Recommendation: Target the high-resistivity zone located between 20m and 38m. Aim for a minimum drilling depth of 40m to ensure full penetration of the primary aquifer.
